a.lede: Megaspeed has been accused of funneling AI chips to China after a former executive's affair with Jensen Huang became public.
a.title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

b.lede: The husband of alleged Chinese spy Alice Huang, the former Megaspeed employee who was involved in an affair with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, has even stronger ties to the Chinese intelligence services, U.S. intelligence officials have told Congress.
b.title: Husband of Jensen Huang’s mistress has much more significant Chinese intelligence connections than her, report claims
